name: dVRK Consortium
description: The dVRK Consortium is an academic and industry collaboration around the open-source [da Vinci Research Kit (dVRK)](/robot/dvrk_dvrk), led by Johns Hopkins University and Worcester Polytechnic Institute in collaboration with [Intuitive](/company/intuitive). It provides open-source control electronics, software, and community resources for research in teleoperation, surgical autonomy, perception, and machine learning using repurposed first-generation [da Vinci](/robot/intuitive_da_vinci) hardware.
